CREATE PROC [DW].[HIST_SP_DW_FACTAVERAGEDAILYBALANCEYTD] @Businessdate [VARCHAR](10) AS
BEGIN

WITH CurrencyConversion AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'),

CasaTdAggregateBalance AS(
    SELECT  * FROM [BNKM].[CasaTdAggregateBalance] WHERE AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance'
    
	),
	
Cnt_DimCustomerAccount AS(
    SELECT BCB.CustomerAccountId, COUNT(1) CNT FROM CasaTdAggregateBalance BCB
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountID 
    and DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
    GROUP BY BCB.CustomerAccountId),
	
Balance AS (
SELECT 
	BCB.PeriodEndDate AS BusinessDateSK
	,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
	,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
	,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
	,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
	,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BCB.AccumulatedCurrentBalance * BCC.ConversionRate) / DDD.DayOfYear
		ELSE BCB.AccumulatedCurrentBalance / DDD.DayOfYear END  AS AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull
	,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN ( (BCB.ACCUMULATEDCURRENTBALANCE * BCC.ConversionRate )/ ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  ) / DDD.DayOfYear
		ELSE (BCB.ACCUMULATEDCURRENTBALANCE / ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  ) / DDD.DayOfYear
		END AS AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
	,BCB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM CasaTdAggregateBalance BCB
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCB.CustomerAccountid = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCB.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CAFP.ProductId = FPA.FinancialproductId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion BCC ON BCA.IsoCurrencyCode = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCB.FinancialInstitutionId = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCB.PeriodEndDate = BCC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON convert(varchar,BCA.BranchId) = DDB.BranchID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON convert(varchar,BCB.FinancialInstitutionId) = convert(varchar,DDBK.BankID)
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON convert(varchar,BCB.CustomerAccountId) = convert(varchar,DDA.AccountID)
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMDATE DDD ON  @Businessdate = DDD.DateSK
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA','SBA','TDA')
AND @Businessdate NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD))

,GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK,
	BankSK,
	AccountSK,
    AccountId,
	SourceSystemCode, 
    MIN(BusinessDateSK) as min_date, 
    CONVERT(DATE, '2023-06-01') max_date 
  FROM 
    Balance
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
    GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	b.BranchSK,
    b.BankSK,
    b.AccountSK,
    b.AccountID,
	b.SourceSystemCode,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,FullDate,112) AS FullDate2,
    a.FullDate, 
    b.min_date, 
    b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
  WHERE 
    (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,Distinct_Balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull, AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm
FROM Balance)
, join_balance as (
select 
 ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate) AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm                           
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BalanceAmount
,CNT
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
, case when [BalanceAmount] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

)

, rowgrp as (
select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup from join_balance
)
,final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,case when BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode is not null then BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode else first_value(BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end IsoCurrencyCode
,case when BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId is not null then BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId else first_value(BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end FinancialInstitutionId
,case when [BalanceAmount] is not null then BalanceAmount else first_value(BalanceAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end BalanceAmount
,case when [CNT] is not null then CNT else first_value(CNT) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CNT
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm                           
from rowgrp BCPB) 

INSERT INTO DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD
SELECT 
	BusinessDateSK
	,BranchSK
	,BankSK
	,AccountSK
	,AccountID
	,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull
	,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM Distinct_Balance b

END
GO
